'''Rodian D-Tec''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] design and manufacturing corporation, based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodia]]. The company manfactured the [[RHTC-560 HT Drone]] and [[RHTC-560 Hunter Trainer]].<ref name="SotEPG" />
